<b>Choir Hornheads</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are full-grown members of [[the Choir]] bearing three horns.<ref>Choir Hornhead [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Full-grown former pilgrim serving the Citadel."</i></ref>
== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Often found simply wandering back and forth, Choir Hornheads charge at Hornet when they detect her, stopping if they hit a wall or she gets behind them. They notably do not attempt to stop themselves from going over edges, occasionally killing themselves as a result.

Choir Hornheads deal {{Damage|1}} both on contact and with their charge.

Needle Bouncing, attacking fast enough to push them away, or simply jumping behind them any time they charge is the most effective way to defeat them.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* To live eternal... in the light...
* I am chosen!
* Your ringing halls...
* Your shining walls...
* The song...
* Where is the song?
* When may I rest?
* Is this the way?
* None shall starve...
* None shall die...
}}

== Location ==
Choir Hornheads can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]]. They also appear during enemy gauntlet at the entrance to [[Whispering Vaults]], accessible from [[Cogwork Core]].

Once [[Second Sentinel]] is activated, it can be found fighting a group of enemies including a unique Hornhead with 55/{{BT|110}} HP.
